name: Cerveja Coral
verdict: Beer brand of Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira (ECM), part of the Pestana Group, owned and chaired by Dionísio Pestana. Nothing found.
note: Madeira beer brand of the Madeira Brewery (Empresa de Cervejas da Madeira, ECM). ECM says it is part of the Pestana Group universe; the group (owner and chairman Dionísio Pestana) says it bought the Madeira brewery in the 1990s. Front-of-shirt sponsor at Nacional in 2026-27; the ECM-Nacional sponsorship was renewed in 2023 for three more years with shirt advertising (DNOTICIAS, 11 Aug 2023). Rating note (2026-10-03): private, family-owned Portuguese owners; no state or state fund in the chain and no human-rights finding against ECM or the Pestana Group found, so nothing passes the METHOD.md test.
